title: explainer profile.json
description: One core/profiles/<kind>/profile.json ('Kinds as profiles'). Validated with lib/schema.mjs's built-ins-only subset (type, const, enum, pattern, minLength, minItems, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, oneOf) — same vocabulary as contents.schema.json, no external schema engine.

schema.description: profile.json format version. Only 1 is understood.

id.description: Profile id — must match the folder name under core/profiles/ (and any pack's profiles/), since the lookup resolves profiles/<kind> by this name.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what this kind of artifact is for.

page_types.description: Page types. Every profile includes a "start-here" kickoff page type.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id. A skeleton page's own "type" names one of these; the two build-generated types are literally "generated-terms"/"generated-sources" (lib/build.mjs special-cases those exact strings).

purpose.description: What this page type answers — used both in guides/<id>.md and as the seed text for a scaffolded placeholder page.

suggested_patterns.description: core/patterns/<name>/ folders a page-writer should reach for first. May be empty (e.g. a build-generated page type).

suggested_diagrams.description: core/diagrams/<kind>/ folders a page-writer should reach for first. May be empty.

guide.description: Path (relative to this profile's own folder) to this page type's short guide.

default_sources.description: Sources this kind of artifact typically draws from. The coordinator's "where to look" interview question pre-selects these and always adds a free-form "Other" option on top, regardless of what's listed here.

kind.description: One of the six source types. `wiki` is a grounding-wiki corpus (docs/wiki), read before code when present.

describe.description: What the fact-gatherer reads for this source, in this profile's context.

hint.description: A short pointer to where/how to look (e.g. a command shape or folder name).

interview.description: The start-of-run interview: audience, purpose, emphasis, and where-to-look, in that order, each a short multiple-choice round.

header.description: Short label (<= 12 characters) for a narrow UI column.

default.description: True when this option should arrive pre-selected (default_sources are pre-selected in the where-to-look round).

freeform.description: True for the always-available "Other" option on the where-to-look round — the answer is free text, not one of the listed sources.

skeleton.description: Every profile's skeleton file is named identically, resolved relative to the profile's own folder.
